provenance.inputs_summary: hybrid screening on the 20 bar baseline

hybrid_psa_tail_membrane.rationale: PSA tail gas carries 24 % of the H2 (the largest loss); a Pd membrane on it could return H2. No source in the library reports this scheme; informational screening only.
hybrid_psa_tail_membrane.conclusion: At the 1.2 bar tail pressure the H2 partial pressure is below the feed side of any practical vacuum permeate; even the pinch limit needs 0.1 bar vacuum and re-compression of the recovered H2 to the PSA feed pressure. Not recommended without a source; kept as informational.

hybrid_membrane_plus_psa_polish.rationale: A Pd membrane with finite H2/N2 selectivity could be followed by a small PSA to remove leaked N2, relaxing the selectivity requirement.
hybrid_membrane_plus_psa_polish.status: not quantified: no published PSA recovery for a ppm-level polishing duty in the library

hybrid_membrane_plus_nh3_polishing_bed.rationale: Measured Pd-Ag permeate NH3 spans 0.01-2.9 ppm (cechetto2023membrane Table 10) so a polishing bed is needed for 0.1 ppm; sourced (clinoptilolite, zeolite 13X). Included as configuration MEM_*_polish.
